cultural.vision_reason: Studio portrait of two named Isleta Pueblo men (Alejandro Padilla and Ambrosio Abeita) in traditional dress with patterned blankets, leggings, and leg ornaments, documenting their attire alongside an unrelated White man; this is a documentary photo of Isleta dress and so belongs.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album; studio portrait of Alejandro Padilla, an Isleta governor, Ambrosio Abeita, an Isleta man, and a White man; Alejandro Padilla is seated on a fringed chair, wearing a cloth shirt, a jacket, leggings, leg ornaments, boots, and a patterned blanket around his waist, a hat is on his knee; Ambrosio Abeita is wearing a cloth shirt, a jacket, leggings, boots, and a patterned blanket around his waist, a hat is on his knee; the White man is standing wearing a three piece suit and a bow tie; Washington DC, United States of America. 
Albumen print
